tasks.title: Implement dashboard-pulse widget (PulseZone + CompactSessionCard)
tasks.description: Create the `packages/web/src/widgets/dashboard-pulse/` widget exporting `PulseZone`. `PulseZone` calls `useActivityCards()` (the Activity page's existing projection of `useAgentActivity`) and renders: a capacity header showing `active/max` slots and the four status pills (active/waiting/completed/failed); a capped list of `CompactSessionCard` (max 4, with a `+N more` overflow link to the Activity page when exceeded); and an empty-state affordance when there are no active sessions. `CompactSessionCard` is a slimmed variant of `ActiveSessionCard` showing only issue number, stage badge, current task title, task progress, token·cost, and context-health color — dropping elapsed time, model, activity previews, tool counts, and anomalies. Reuse `ContextHealthIndicator`, `formatCompact`, `formatCost`, and the `STAGE_COLORS` map; consume the existing `SessionCard` model type from `activity-cards.ts`. No new query key, endpoint, or domain write.
acceptanceCriteria: PulseZone renders a capacity header displaying `active/max` slot usage and active/waiting/completed/failed counts sourced from `useActivityCards()`.
PulseZone renders one `CompactSessionCard` per active session, capped at 4; when exceeded, a `+N more` link to the Activity page renders as a footer.

CompactSessionCard displays issue number, issue stage badge, current task title (falling back to task description), task progress (completed/total + thin bar) when present, token usage and cost on a single compact line when available, and a context-health color via `ContextHealthIndicator`.
CompactSessionCard does NOT render elapsed time, model name, activity previews, tool/error counts, failure category, or anomaly indicators.
When the active session list is empty, PulseZone renders an empty-state affordance in the card-list area while the capacity header still shows `0/max`.
PulseZone does not issue a new query key or backend call; it consumes the same `useActivityCards()` / `['agent-activity', ...]` cache the Activity page uses.

Unit tests cover: capacity header values, card field rendering, context-health color, empty state, overflow cap behavior, and absence of a separate query — all passing via `npm run test:run -w packages/web`.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes with no new errors.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/widgets/dashboard-pulse/ (index.ts, ui/PulseZone.tsx, ui/CompactSessionCard.tsx, and co-located .test.tsx files)
tasks.notes: Follow FSD widget conventions used by packages/web/src/widgets/coder-session. The capacity header should reuse StatusBar's pill color tokens (bg-blue-100/amber-100/green-100/red-100) but not the full StatusBar component, which is a top-bar layout. Long text fields use single-line -webkit-line-clamp to prevent half-width overflow. No 1s `now` ticker is needed because CompactSessionCard omits elapsed time.

tasks.title: Mount PulseZone into Dashboard via DashboardZone wrapper and update dashboard-shell tests
tasks.spec: specs/dashboard-shell/spec.md#Dashboard provides four zone mount-point slots
tasks.description: Replace `DashboardZonePlaceholder` with a `DashboardZone` presentational wrapper that renders the same slot container (`data-testid="dashboard-zone-<id>"`, `data-zone`, `aria-label`) and accepts optional children. Add a `renderZoneContent(id)` switch in `DashboardPage` that returns `<PulseZone />` for the `pulse` slot and null for the other three. Update the existing dashboard-shell capability tests to match the MODIFIED requirement: the pulse slot now renders `dashboard-pulse` content, while attention/productivity/digest remain empty placeholders. The slot identity and mount-point contract stay unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: The `attention`, `productivity`, and `digest` slots still render as empty placeholders (no zone content).
`DashboardZone` wrapper preserves the `data-testid="dashboard-zone-<id>"`, `data-zone`, and `aria-label` attributes for every slot, filled or empty.
Existing dashboard-shell tests are updated to assert the MODIFIED contract: pulse slot has content, other three slots are empty, all four slot identities remain stable.
`npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes including the updated dashboard-shell tests.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes with no new errors.
tasks.output: packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/ui/DashboardZone.tsx (replaces DashboardZonePlaceholder), updated DashboardPage.tsx with renderZoneContent, updated dashboard-shell tests under packages/web/src/pages/dashboard/ui/*.test.tsx
tasks.notes: Keep the slot container attributes byte-identical to the current DashboardZonePlaceholder so downstream selectors and tests that key off data-testid/data-zone continue to work. The renderZoneContent switch is the single extension point for future zones (Attention/Productivity/Digest).
